resolved_conflicts.explanation: The westlookouts directory lists the peak under the Teton National Forest, while Wikipedia places it inside Grand Teton National Park. The record's agency is left as recorded for an editor to check against the park boundary.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no lookout build date, staffing, design or fate appears in any source read. Wikipedia places the peak in Grand Teton National Park, while the directory says Teton National Forest; agency left unchanged. Wikipedia coordinates (44.00889, -110.82944) differ slightly from the record (44.0083, -110.82868); not treated as an error. Story body is about 150 words; every claim in it is sourced, so nothing was padded. Searches for a Forellen lookout turned up nothing dated.
